studentDocument.title: Epigenetic Dysregulation in Oncogenesis
studentDocument.text:
Epigenetic modifications such as DNA methylation and histone acetylation alter chromatin architecture without changing the underlying genomic nucleotide sequence.

Recent clinical trials demonstrate that aberrant hypermethylation of tumor suppressor promoter regions represents an early biomarker in colorectal oncology.
